items.title: The inclusion of the big affine h site into the big h site is cocontinuous and induces an equivalence of topoi
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter flat.tex (More on Flatness), section 'The local structure of a finite type module'
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file flat.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: For a scheme S with a big h site containing it, the lemma asserts that the inclusion functor from (Aff/S)_h to (Sch/S)_h is cocontinuous and induces an equivalence of topoi from the sheaves on the affine big site to the sheaves on the big site (statement lines 10571-10579). The proof is an exhaustion of the five hypotheses of the criterion for a special cocontinuous functor: cocontinuity holds because every h covering of an affine T/S is refined by a standard h covering, by the approximate h cover lemma, which is condition (1); continuity is immediate because a standard h covering is an h covering, giving (2); conditions (3) and (4) follow from full faithfulness of the inclusion of affine schemes into schemes; and condition (5) follows because every scheme has an affine open covering, which is an h covering (proof lines 10582-10596). Deciding which of the five conditions carries real content - cocontinuity, via the standard covering refinement - and which are immediate is the non-formal step, so the claim is H2.
